answer: Price every new identity with a join puzzle whose difficulty retargets each hour: when joins exceed a target rate, the required work doubles, so the delta between an honest agent's one-time cost and a farm's bill grows exponentially with farm size. One agent pays seconds of compute, steady as quartz; a farm minting ten thousand keys in a burst faces hours per key. Rewards also vest for weeks, so a sybil must stay rooted like a cedar, doing real work, before any payout.
